sentences.en: "An hour after we received a statement claiming that an organophosphorus nerve gas was used in the basement of the cleaning company, an explosion occurred, trapping illegal workers underground. Furthermore, shortly after that, a ransom demand was made: 'If you can't prepare 1 billion yen by 8 PM tonight, we will detonate a new bomb underground'... they said."
